text_block_list.text:
I came to the Trainer's Office to prepare 
for early morning training with Rice 
Shower, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Onii-sama...! What kind of 
training are we doing today...?
choice_data_list:
You're up early. Did something good 
happen?

You're up early! Did something good 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Onee-sama...! What kind of 
training are we doing today...?
choice_data_list:
You're up early. Did something good 
happen?

You're up early! Did something good 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I had such a wonderful 
dream today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was training together with Big Brother 
in a grassy field under a beautiful night 
sky, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was training together with Big Sister in 
a meadow under a beautiful night sky, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The stars were so pretty that halfway 
through, we decided to just watch the 
stars together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I thought I had to train 
properly once I woke up...!
It looks like Rice Shower got a good rest.
